planlar.metin: [surprised] Hasan Amca, tezgahtaki bütün taze simitler nerede?!

Flashback shot of a traditional red street simit cart in Bursa with Uludağ mountain visible in the distance.

planlar.metin: [sighs] Abi martı haklı, susamlar mis gibi kokuyor...

Dynamic production scene at the simit cart in Bursa cobblestone plaza.
